spec.claim_summary: The claim describes trading price against its slowest moving average with higher confidence when ten timeframes align.
spec.untestable_reason: No mechanical rule can be recovered because MA lengths, signal direction, assets and exits are unspecified and the core alignment across ten timeframes needs multi-timeframe data.
assumptions: No asset named; assumed BTCUSDT as default test asset.
No single timeframe named, only 10 different time frames; assumed 1d to represent a single timeframe.
No MA length, MA type, signal direction, or exit stated in 'lowest Moving average against Price' and 'average price moves against its slowest tracking average'.

NOT EXPRESSIBLE: alignment across 10 different time frames requiring multi-timeframe conditions, plus unspecified moving-average parameters and entry/exit triggers left out, which is the heart of the strategy.
